DISQUALIFICATION APPEAL

IN PHOTOS | Members of the League of Parents of the Philippines and Hands Off Our Children hold a picket rally outside the Commission on Elections office in Intramuros, Manila on Tuesday (October 14). 

The groups asked for the ouster of Gabriela and the Kabataan party-lists from the House of Representatives due to their supposed involvement in alleged recruitment of the youth by communist groups. 

📷 Norman Cruz

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.
